claim_boundary: This sweep mutates only input surface addresses before L1/L2 preparation; target and wrong outputs stay unchanged.
interpretation: Role/source token address radius is relatively robust: suffix typos on source tokens keep sequence energy at 975-983 milli with positive p10 gaps. Action/operator address is fragile: wrapping the action text drops energy to 904 milli and nearly erases p10 gap; combining action wrapper with one source typo turns p10 negative. This supports the diagnosis that action/operator separability is the next key bottleneck.
